content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(AIRS LLM08 RAG Response Contains AKIA Canary From Poisoned Document) OR XQL(AIRS LLM08 RAG Ingestion Classifier Flags Embedded System Override Block) OR XQL(AIRS LLM08 Indirect Injection Scorer Fires On Retrieved Context)
rules.name: AIRS LLM08 RAG Poison Upload Plus Retrieval Triggered Leak
